release_name: Live TV v5.1.3 — Professional Sports Broadcast UI & Match Info Toggle
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🏟️ Professional Sports Broadcast UI: Completely redesigned live sports cards inspired by Apple TV+ and ESPN with glassmorphic cards, monospaced scoreboards, and sleek left accent lines without bulky boxes

👁️ 1-Click Show / Hide Information Toggle: Instant toggle between Compact Mode (minimalist score strips) and Detailed Mode (full telemetry, series subtitle, time, and summaries) with persisted preference
✕ 1-Click Section Dismiss & Toolbar Toggle: Easily hide or show the entire Live Sports carousel from the section header (✕) or top tools bar (🔥 Sports)
⚡ Prominent Header Update Icon & Status Pill: Always-visible update badge and 1-click live GitHub version check
🗜️ Ultra-Compact Desktop Header: Zero horizontal scroll across all screen sizes
📱 Scroll-Free Phone TV & Remote: Optimized single-screen layout with zero scrollbars
🛡️ 100% Ad-Free Live TV (Zero-Ad Shield): Zero commercial interruptions across all 2,989 channels
